practiceOverview.title: Legal protection for every immigration situation.

deportation.title: Deportation Defense
deportation.desc: When the government files removal proceedings, we stand between you and deportation. Every hearing, every motion, every argument.

asylum.title: Political Asylum
asylum.desc: If you fled persecution in your home country, the law may protect you here. We build the strongest possible case for your safety.

bond.title: Bond Hearings
bond.desc: Your loved one is detained. Every day inside is a day too many. We fight for their release — fast.

family.title: Family Petitions
family.desc: Reuniting families through I-130 petitions, adjustment of status, and consular processing. The paperwork is ours — the reunion is yours.

vawaU.title: VAWA & U-Visa
vawaU.desc: Survivors of abuse and crime have legal protections. You don't need your abuser's permission to apply. We handle everything — confidentially.

naturalization.title: Naturalization & Citizenship
naturalization.desc: You've earned the right to call this country home. We handle your N-400 application, interview prep, and everything in between.

whyVerde.title: We're not just another firm. We're your team.
whyVerde.body1: Rafael Verde founded this firm straight out of law school with one idea: that every immigrant in the United States deserves an attorney who answers the phone, speaks their language, and fights like it's personal.
whyVerde.body2: Most firms treat immigration cases like a conveyor belt — file the form, bill the client, move on. We don't. Every case here gets Rafael's personal review. Every client has a paralegal who knows their name, their story, and their next deadline. We return calls the same day, we explain things in plain language, and we don't stop until your case is resolved.

bilingual.title: Your language, always
bilingual.desc: Every person at Verde Law speaks Spanish. You will never need a translator, never feel lost in your own case, and never wonder what your attorney just said.

national.title: 50 states. One firm.
national.desc: Immigration law is federal. A Florida-licensed attorney can represent you in any immigration court in the country. We appear in person when required, remotely when allowed.

free.title: Free consultation — no strings
free.desc: We evaluate your case at no cost. No credit card. No commitment. No follow-up calls pressuring you to sign. If we're not the right fit, we'll tell you — and we'll tell you who is.

tech.title: Your case, tracked in real time
tech.desc: With Verde+, our immigration platform, you see exactly where your case stands — 24/7, from your phone. No more calling the office and waiting for a callback.

process.title: Four steps. No retainer until we agree on a plan.

step1.title: Free Consultation
step1.desc: Call, WhatsApp, or schedule online. A real person — not a bot — walks through your situation in 15–30 minutes. No cost. No pressure.

step2.title: Case Evaluation
step2.desc: Our attorneys review the facts, identify your options, and tell you honestly what's possible — and what isn't. You'll know exactly where you stand.

step3.title: Legal Preparation
step3.desc: We build your case — declarations, evidence packages, expert testimony, everything. You'll know what we're filing before we file it.

step4.title: Full Representation
step4.desc: We represent you from the first hearing to the final decision. If the judge rules against us, we discuss appeals the same day. We don't disappear after filing.

attorneyFeature.name: Rafael Verde
attorneyFeature.body1: Rafael Verde founded Verde Law in 2024 — weeks after passing the bar and before most of his classmates had decided which firm to join. The bet was simple: that there was a real market for a humanitarian immigration firm that treated Spanish-speaking families the way corporate clients get treated — with urgency, with respect, and with an attorney who actually knows their name.
attorneyFeature.body2: Today, the team is 22 people strong. The firm handles cases across the Eleventh Circuit, in federal appeals courts, and in immigration courts from Krome to Chicago to Los Angeles. Rafael personally reviews every new case. He still answers his own phone on weekends. Thousands of families later, the bet paid off.
